tei:div.tei:p: "!#'u'u'u: thugs rje chen po pad+ma'i dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs gsang ba gcig grub bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈ na ma ār+ya lo ke shwa ra ya: thugs rje chen po pad+ma dbang phyug gi: gsang ba ye shes gcig grub nyams len gnad: gtor glud dag gis bgegs rnams tshims byas te: mtshams bcad bde ba'i gdan la rab tu gnas: 1$0000250dal 'byor las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam: mi rtag skul mas rang rgyud chos dang bsre: khams gsum gnas kun gang du btsal na yang: bde ba'i gnas ni gang gis sbyin mi nus: gtan gyi bde ba dkon mchog gsum la yod: bslab bya phan yon drug ldan skyabs 'gro la: rtag tu rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis bsten: 1$0000300 de ni med thabs med pa'i lam gyi srog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: hrī: mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od gur khang dbus: dkyil 'khor dbang phyug kun bzang snang mtha' yas: thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs shing bzhugs: dbang skur byin rlobs mchog gi dngos grub stsol: hrī: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i 'bras bu'i chos: smin grol thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa'i: snang ba mtha' yas mgon po spyan ras gzigs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal: hrī: phyi mchod 'dod yon rnam lnga gtsang zhing mdzes: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yid du 'ong: sman gtor rak+ta gser skyems dang re spro: sgeg bzhad lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas rnams 'bul: hrī: bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis: mi dge bcu dang mtshams med chen po lnga: nye ba lnga dang lci bzhi log pa brgyad: rang bzhin bcas dang 'gal ba'i nyes kun bshags: hrī: so so skye bo 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang: sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma rig 'dzin gyi: dus gsum zag med dge tshogs thams cad la: dad pas rjes su yi rang 'bul bar bgyi: hrī: bla ma bde gshegs rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'gro rnams las dang ma rig rkyen dbang gis: chos kyis phongs pa'i mun 'thoms 'khyams gyur na:

theg gsum sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol: hrī: gang zhig gdul bya'i spyod pas thugs chad cing: dus las yol bas zhing khams gzhan rnams su: gshegs par dgongs pa'i skyes chen thams cad kyang: srid mtsho bsgral slad yun du bzhugs su gsol: hrī: bdag gzhan dge ba'i lo tog ji snyed kun: yun gyi bde bas 'gro kun tshims byed phyir: snying po mchog gi sa la gnas bya'i phyir: 'khor gsum mi dmigs kun bzang klong du bsngo: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: zhes pa'i bsnyen pa brgya stong dag tu bzla: tshogs gsag maṇ+ḍal bkod 'phags bshams byas la: hrī: dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la: ri rgyal lhun po brjid cing 'gying bag ldan: gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho bdun bcas: mnyen lcugs sra brtan rin chen rtsig par ldan: gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams bskor: lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rgyan gyis brgyan: nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa sel: lcags ri mu khyud mtha' nas legs par bskor: phyi ltar snod kyi 'jig rten snang ba 'di: bla ma thugs rje chen po'i tshogs la 'bul: bdag gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas: yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shog: hrī: bdag gi yul 'khor longs spyod 'dod yon dang: pha ma bu tsha mdza' ba'i grogs la sogs: 'dzin pa'i yid kyis gces par bzung ba rnams: bla ma thugs rje chen po'i tshogs la 'bul: bdag gi nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i yul dag nas: dag pa'i ye shes chen po bstan du gsol: hrī: bdag lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i pho brang nas: sems kyi rten gnas tsit+ta 'bar ba la: dbang po lnga yi rten gyis mtha' rten byas: rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'khor gyis rab tu brgyan: sha khrag rus pa nang khrol sna tshogs ldan: mig gnyis dwangs ma'i 'od kyis mun pa sel: bdag lus phung khams skye mched sgyu lus 'di: bla ma thugs rje chen po'i tshogs la 'bul:

bdag gi yid yul 'khrul snang kun dag nas: rang rig ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsol: tshogs zhing 'od zhu rang dang gnyis su med: ma bcos khyab gdal zung 'jug ngang la bzhag: de ni sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i gdams pa 'o: sa ma ya: dngos bzhi sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang: bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pa bstan pa ni: hrī: bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa: yang dag don gyi snying po ma thob pas: mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams: dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma mchog khyod la: snying nas dad pa'i shugs kyis skyabs su mchi: hrī: bdag gis smon 'jug sems bskyed la brten nas: 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las: myur du thar nas byang chub thob par bya: sa ma ya ma hā yo ga tsit+ta hūm̐: hrī: sems can bde dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal bral: mi 'bral bde thob btang snyoms la gnas shog: oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hrī: mkha' khyab gzhal yas khang gi bkod pa ni: zhing khams chen po gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus: 'byung ba yongs rdzogs dwangs pa'i rin chen mtsho: yongs su rgyas pa'i dbus su skyes pa yi: pad+ma'i sdong po khri 'phang gsum dang ldan: yal ga me tog 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci: chu bya sna tshogs theg gsum chos sgra sgrog: phan tshun chos kyi rol tshims gar thabs sgyur: yal 'dab re re'ang mchod pa'i lha mos brgyan: snyan pa'i glu dbyangs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod: rig 'dzin du ma gser g.yu byu ru yi: mdog mtshungs bung ba'i tshul bzung theg chen chos: brda dang stabs kyis skal ldan rnams la sgrog: rin chen ne'u seng brag ri'i tshal gyis bskor: de dag rnams la drang srong rig 'dzin gnas: ma yengs bsam gtan ting 'dzin ros gang ba'i: ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub par bzhugs: phyogs mtshams ma lus ye shes 'od kyi gur: rab mdzes mdangs bkra rim gsum rnam par gsal:

steng phyogs nam mkha' 'od kyi sprin phung na: rig 'dzin lha dang mkha' 'gro dpag med kyis: bdud rtsi'i khrus gsol me tog man+dā ra: kha dog sna tshogs char 'beb rol mo sgrog: ri bo chen po po ta la 'dra yi: ji ltar rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing gi dbus: 'od snang dkyil 'khor chu skyes zla ba'i steng: skad cig dran rdzogs chu la nya 'phar ltar: rang rig hrīḥdakar mdangs ldan 'od 'phro bas: rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs hrīḥl thim: slar 'phros 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel byas nas: de ltar 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: pad+ma'i dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dkar gsal mdangs ldan zhal 'dzum bzhad pa'i tshul: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dgos 'dod re ba skong: g.yon pa sta zur nas brkyang gdan 'ding mdzad: pad dkar yu ba mtheb mdzub la gnas pa'i: yal ga lo 'dab snyan shal phyogs kun mdzes: srid zhir mi gnas zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul: yid 'ong mtshan dang dpe byad lhun gyis grub: smin mtshams mdzod spu 'od lnga'i thig ler 'khyil: zhi tshul dgu ldan rgyan cha bcu gsum 'chang: dbu skra thor tshugs zur phud nor bus spras: kun nas bkrag mdangs 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar: thugs rje'i brtse bas 'gro la lhag ger gzigs: 'od phung stug po sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i nang: 'gag med chos kyi sku dang dbyer med bzhugs: hrī: spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba la: sku yi rdo rje rnam snang dkar ba'i zhal: rang 'dra'i 'od kyi yum dang snyoms par zhugs: phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pas dril bu bsnams: mgrin par longs spyod pad+ma dmar po'i dbus: gsung gi rdo rje snang mtha' dmar ba'i zhal: rang 'dra'i 'od kyi yum dang snyoms par zhugs: phyag g.yas pad+ma g.yon pa dril bu bsnams: thugs kar chos 'khor rdo rje'i lte bar ni: thugs kyi rdo rje mi bskyod sngo ba'i zhal:

rang 'dra'i 'od kyi yum dang snyoms par zhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa dril bu bsnams: kun kyang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam par bzhugs: hrī: lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i chos 'byung dbus: sna tshogs pad nyi bam gyi gdan steng du: gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig khro 'dzum phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis: gri gug thod khrag thugs kar dkrug cing gsol: lhag ma'i phyag gnyis ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: zhabs gnyis gar stabs phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan: phyogs bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhi nyi ma'i gdan: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: mthing ser dmar ljang phyag gnyis gri thod dang: dar snas spras pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon na 'chang: zhabs rnams 'dor stabs gyen gzigs tshul du bzhugs: kun kyang phyag rgya lnga ldan gar nyams ldan: gnas yul dur khrod drug cu rtsa bzhi yi: dpa' bo rnal 'byor grangs med ldan pa rnams: gcig tu ma nges sku mdog phyag mtshan bcas: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor gyi tshul du ste: ma lus til gyi gang bu lta bur bzhugs: hrī: rdo rje lus kyi phung po bye brag lnga: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags: de bzhin khams lnga rigs kyi yum chen lnga: mig sogs dbang po'i skye mched sems dpa' yab: yul du snang dus rtog pa sems ma 'o: reg dang tshor ba'i rtog pa khro bo ste: rtag dang chad pa mu bzhi khro mo 'o: nyon mongs drug ni thub drug dbang phyug ma: kun bzang ma bcos kun la khyab par gdal: skye 'gag gnas dmigs 'gro 'ong smon dang 'jug: mi gnas ye shes gsang ba thugs kyi ngang: mnyam gzhag mi g.yo cho 'phrul rang byung shar: snang ba snang byed zhi dang khro bor bzhugs: hrīḥbo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu ā: gtso 'khor lha rnams gsal ba'i gnas gsum du: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dkar dmar mthing gas mtshan: gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros

bsam: hrī: gsal brtan ting 'dzin ye shes rol pa las: sgyu 'phrul gar ldan dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang nas: thugs rje smon lam dbang gis gshegs su gsol: e h+ye hi lo ke shwa ra bha ga bān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dri sh+ya ho: e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdza: hrī: gdod nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las: blo sbyong phyir du dam tshig ye shes sems: chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du: du mar snang yang ro gcig brtan par bya: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra lhan: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hrī: kun 'dus thugs rje chen po lha yi tshogs: rang shes 'khrul bral brda dang gar gyi phyag: rnam dag ye shes chen po rtogs bya'i phyir: sri zhu gus pas 'phrul dga'i tshul phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: hrī: ye shes glu bro don gyi brdas mtshon nas: dga' ba bcu drug glu dbyangs bro dang gar: yang dag don rtogs rang byung rang la mchod: rtogs pa'i ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol: ma hā dz+nyā na te te hūm̐: te te te na hūm̐: hrī: ting 'dzin cho 'phrul ye shes rol pa las: pha rol phyin pa drug rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin: nam mkha'i khams kun legs par bkang nas kyang: rang byung thugs rje chen po'i tshogs la 'bul: hrīḥbadz+ra ā ha ra ā ha ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: hrī: gsang ba yum gyi bde ba dam pa ni: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos rnams te: 'dod yon ma 'gags rang byung lha mo yi: bde ba dam pa sems kyi rgyan du 'bul: pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū tsa ho: hrī: rang byung gdod nas grub pa rdzas kyi mchog: sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga ye shes lnga: dag mnyam rtogs pas rang byung lnga la mchod: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī:

hrī: khyad par rmad byung 'dod yon rnam lnga dang: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal sogs: sha khrag rus pa'i rdzas su lhun gyis grub: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig mchog gi rten: zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma longs spyod rgyan: lha mchog thugs rje chen po'i tshogs la 'bul: ma hā ba liṃ ta pū tsa khā hi: hrī: mnyam nyid dag pa rgyal ba'i ye shes sku: rtsol med rang byung ā li kā li'i sgra: rtog med spros bral 'od gsal thig le'i thugs: rtsol dang bral ba lhun grub yon tan gter: rang bzhin ma nges phrin las lhun gyis grub: khyab bdag mgon po spyan ras gzigs la bstod: hrī: skye med sku yi rol pa 'gag pa med: thugs rje sprul skus 'jig rten khyab par 'gengs: zhi rgyas dbang drag cir yang ston mdzad pa: pad+ma dbang phyug nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso: steng 'og phyogs bzhir rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis: 'khor du mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab drug dbus: lte bar hrīḥdang 'dab mar yig 'bru bkod: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: kun kyang dkar dmar mdangs ldan 'od 'phro gsal: gsang bar ḍā ki'i thugs kar chos 'byung dbus: baṃ las khug pa gsum por ḍā ki nī: phyogs kyi rigs bzhi ḍā ki'i thugs ka ru: dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yas su 'khyil ba re: de yi lte bar so so'i sa bon bkod: ha ri ni sa yig 'bru gsal zhing bskor: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: baṃ ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐: gtso las 'od 'phros 'khor gyi sa bon g.yos: kun las 'od 'phros rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskul: kun kyang lha yi ngo bor bkug la bstim: sngags kyi sgra sgrog dir dir stong khams khengs: gang shar 'dzin med snying rje'i ngang nas bzlas: bsnyen pa bye lnga sgrub pa bye gnyis kyis:

rtags dang mtshan ma ya mtshan brjod las 'das: skye ba gcig gis bde ba can du 'khod: the tshom med do snying du sa ma ya: thun mtshams mchod gtor 'bul zhing bstod pa bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: hrīḥsarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra maṇ+ḍal ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai bid+ya= shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta āḥhūm̐: rin chen snod nang 'byor tshogs gtor ma bsham: bsang sbyangs byin brlabs rgya chen mang du spel: hrī: skye med chos dbyings rol pa chen po'i gnas: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: thugs rje che mnga' bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus gshegs su gsol: hrīḥlo ke shwa ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng dgyes par bzhugs: gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: ar+ghaṃ me tog spos me dri chab dang: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: chos dang sman gtor rak+ta tshogs mchod kyis: bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru lo ke shwa ra dhe ba ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa ma ya ḍā ki nī sarba pū tsa ga ṇa tsakra ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hrī: tsan+dan gur gum ga pur gla rtsi dang: gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig bai ḍūr bcas: sha lnga bdud rtsi dpal gyi gtor ma dang: gzhan yang spyan gzigs mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: hrī: yang dag rtogs pa'i ye shes rnam pa lnga: zhi gnas lhag mthong ting 'dzin bsam mi khyab: dge bcu rnam dag spyod pa'i dgyes mchod ni: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba dz+nyā na ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: hrī: thugs rje chen po pad+ma dbang phyug sku: sku mdog dkar gsal 'gro kun mun pa sel: thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la rnam par gzigs: 'gro ba 'dul mdzad nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hrī: thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku: gar gyi dbang phyug pad+ma gsung gi lha: skyon bral dri med thugs kyi rdo rje nyid: sku gsum mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: spyi mgrin thugs dbus rdo rje gsum gyi lha: yab yum 'khril sbyor bde ba'i nyams dang ldan: lte bar gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki ma: phrin las rnam bzhi'i mkha' 'gror bcas la 'dud: phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs: gnyis med don gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ lo ke shwa ra sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: lo ke shwa ra twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dri ḍho me bha ba: su to ṣ+yo me bha ba: su po ṣ+yo me bha ba: a nu rak+to me bha ba: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karmā su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya: lo ke shwa ra ma me muñtsa badz+rī bha ba: ma hā sa ma ya satwa lo ke shwa ra ā:

de rjes rnam pa gsal ba lha nyid la: yid ni rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag par bya: lus ni snang stong sgyu ma lha yi sku: ngag ni grags stong gzhom med rdo rje'i sgra: 'pho chen bcu gnyis dbu mar rdzogs par byed: sems ni gsal stong rang bzhin rnam thar gsum: snying po rig pa sku dang ye shes lnga: skye 'chi med pa'i g.yung drung nyid du gsal: nyam dang ldang dus 'od gsal sgyu lus bsgom: ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyus rtag tu bzung: nad gdon bgegs zhi tshe ring nad dang bral: rmi lam nyi shar me tog thod du bcings: rdo rje dril bu cang te'u dkrol ba dang: zas nor tshogs 'du nyams dga' shes pa gsal: kun la byams ldan mos gus dag snang 'char: rjes la snod bcud snying ga'i hrīḥl bsdu: hrīḥyang mi dmigs rdo rje gsang ba'i mkhar: stong gsal rig pa ma bcos chos skur bdal: ldang tshe thugs rje chen po nyid du gyur: gnas gsum 'bru gsum sngags kyis srung ba ste: snod bcud zhing dang 'gro ba lha ru blta: dmigs med bsngo ba smon lam shis pa brjod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000280 pad+ma drā ba can gyi rgyud nas bcud bsdus pa 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rnyed par dka': rje 'bangs rnams kyis gsang ba'i nyams len mdzod: mtsho rgyal yi ger bris shig sa ma ya: blo ldan shes rab can dang 'di 'phrad nas: phyi ma'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku shes rab 'od zer gyis bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rang byon rnam par snang mdzad kyi seng khri'i logs nas spyan drangs pa'o// rje de nyid kyis seng shog leb nas dag par phab pa'o/// /
